alt_when: while Divine Favor is at its max (5 to 8 stacks, by Divine Favor's level)
cooldown: none of its own; shares Necrotic Resurrection's
name: Sacrificial Penance
notes: In game (hwp_pri_necrotic_resurrection at max Divine Favor, tested): the same key; 3 s channel on an intact body, mana 50, removes 1/1/2/2/3 Heresy plus 1 for an elite's body and 2 for a boss's (rank 5 on a boss body: 5), spends all Divine Favor, starts no cooldown. Below max Favor the cast is a raise. The priest dodges to just under the body and faces it while a golden light grows out of the body as the channel runs; the mana is spent when it completes. plan-forgemaster-bosses 20261022-144616, plan-forgemaster-eat 20261022-154317. Assumed: the elite/boss bonus is added to the level's number (the user's call).
summary: Channel for 3 seconds on an intact body to sacrifice it and wash away Heresy. Consumes your Divine Favor.
